your_book:
Monday was a rough session for Jaleel's book, with the portfolio's overall unrealized gain sitting at 5.95% and most of the heavier holdings giving ground. The two biggest drags by weight were ServiceNow (NOW, ~6.1% of the book), which fell 5.08% — the sharpest single-day loss in the portfolio — and Adobe (ADBE, ~5.0%), which dropped 3.78%. Lululemon (LULU, ~4.1%) and On Holding (ONON, ~4.3%) both shed roughly 3% as well, continuing a soft stretch for the consumer-apparel sleeve. On the positive side, Rocket Lab (RKLB, ~8.1%) added 2.28%, Vertex Pharma (VRTX) gained 1.94%, and Neurocrine (NBIX) ticked up 1.16%, though none of those are large enough weights to offset the damage from NOW and ADBE.

Drift is the real concern in two spots. LULU is down 9.5% overall and carries an elevated risk flag for consecutive Americas comp declines and margin compression — the BUY verdict increasingly needs justification as price and thesis pull apart. Similarly, ZTS (Zoetis, ~9.5% weight — the second-largest position) is down 7.3% in total and slipped another 1.11% today, yet the system rates it STRONG BUY with a solid QARP of 76.2; that divergence needs watching closely. RKLB remains the structural oddity: it's the third-largest position by weight at 8.1%, bounced today, but carries an AVOID verdict and a QARP of just 36.6 — the lowest in the book by a wide margin.

Watch three upcoming catalysts: NVDA reports August 26, carrying export-control overhang; ADBE's next read comes September 10, where the AI-moat narrative rather than fundamentals will likely drive the reaction; and LULU's next event is September 2, which could either stabilize or deepen what is now the book's worst unrealized loss. The pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) got a small bid today but remains under a drug-pricing policy cloud.

attention.headline: Fell 5.08% today — largest single-day loss in the book
attention.note: No fresh negative catalyst is visible in the provided data, making this a potentially sentiment- or macro-driven flush, but at ~6.1% weight a continued de-rate of high-multiple software would accelerate drawdown; the thesis and price need to be reconciled before the Oct 27 earnings date.

attention.headline: Third-largest position carries an AVOID verdict and the book's lowest QARP (36.6)
attention.note: An 8.1% weight in a capital-preservation book rated AVOID is a structural mismatch that today's 2.28% bounce does nothing to resolve — a sizing decision is overdue.

attention.headline: Down 9.5% overall, elevated risk flag, next read September 2
attention.note: Five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff-driven margin pressure, and a stalled China business mean the BUY verdict is increasingly unsupported by price action, and the September 2 event is a binary risk.

attention.headline: Second-largest position down 7.3% overall despite STRONG BUY rating
attention.note: The widening gap between a 76.2 QARP / STRONG BUY verdict and a deepening unrealized loss demands a reassessment of whether the thesis is intact or the rating is lagging deteriorating fundamentals.
